{"path": "neuron_growth_openrouter-deepseek-deepseek-v4.1-flash_01.html", "edit_description": "Create a complete self-contained single-file HTML neon "neuron growth" simulation. Requirements:

STRUCTURE (single HTML file, no external assets except dat.gui CDN):
- <canvas id="c" width="800" height="800"> centered on a dark page background (#05070f).
- Include dat.gui via <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/dat-gui/0.7.9/dat.gui.min.js"></script> (only allowed external library).
- Vanilla JS only, no modules/frameworks.
- Short comments explaining major sections: setup, GUI setup, neuron growth, synapse detection, pulse animation, rendering.

EXACT NEON PALETTE (use these hex values as defaults in code and GUI):
- background: #05070f
- background glow: #101a3a
- main branch: #00e5ff
- accent branch: #d6ff00
- synapse: #ff2bd6
- pulse: #fff36a
- UI/accent: #ffd400
- grid/scanline: rgba(0,229,255,0.08)

GUI (dat.gui), folders: Growth, Synapses, Pulses, Visuals.
Growth folder controls: neuron count (3-8, default random 3-6), branch growth speed (0.1-4), max branch depth (1-8), branch split chance (0-1), branch curvature (0-1), max branch length (10-200), max total branches (100-4000).
Synapses folder: synapse distance threshold (4-60), synapse glow strength (0-40).
Pulses folder: pulse speed (0.1-6), pulse frequency (0-2), pulse brightness (0-3).
Visuals folder: background color, branch color, accent branch color, synapse color, pulse color (all color pickers), plus toggles: show grid, show scanlines, vignette, glow on/off.
Buttons at root: "regenerate network", "clear canvas", "pause / resume". Also a display-only info line maybe. Use gui.add(obj, 'regenerate') etc. Implement pause/resume as a button that toggles a boolean and updates its name via controller.name().

SIMULATION:
- Generate 3-6 random seed neurons near canvas center.
- Each neuron recursively grows branching lines. Growth must be ANIMATED step-by-step (each frame advance each active branch tip by growthSpeed pixels), not instant.
- Branches move in slightly random directions, smooth organic curves: store tip position, angle, curvature; each step angle += curvature * random walk; draw segments using quadraticCurveTo between previous points for organic feel (or store polyline points and draw quadratic smoothing through midpoints).
- Randomly vary branch thickness (slightly) per branch.
- Occasionally generate smaller side branches (based on split chance).
- Limit recursion depth (maxDepth) and total branch count (maxBranches) for stable performance.

CONNECTIONS / SYNAPSES:
- When two branch TIPS come within synapse distance threshold, create a synapse.
- Prevent duplicate synapses: use a key set of "tipA|tipB" ids; also skip if same parent branch.
- Synapses glow softly (shadowBlur = synapseGlow) and pulse over time (sin-based alpha).
- Animate short electric pulses traveling between connected tips.
- Pulses move smoothly using linear interpolation along the synapse segment.
- Store network in lightweight arrays/objects only.

AFTER GENERATION:
- Stop growing once network reaches stable size (all branches finished growing or maxBranches reached).
- Continuously spawn random pulses traveling along existing synapses (rate controlled by pulse frequency).
- Randomly activate different paths over time.
- Keep scene alive after growth ends.

VISUAL EFFECTS:
- Thin glowing neon branches (lineWidth ~0.6-2 with shadowBlur).
- Synapses glow brighter than branches.
- Pulses drawn as small bright sparks with strong shadowBlur.
- Subtle bloom via shadowBlur only.
- Faint vignette around canvas edges (radial gradient).
- Optional lightweight scanlines + subtle animated background noise drawn on canvas only (no images).
- Smooth animation with requestAnimationFrame and delta-time normalization.

PERFORMANCE:
- Lightweight rendering, no particle systems, no physics/pathfinding. Cap branch count. Reuse arrays. Clear canvas each frame with background color then draw background glow gradient.

IMPORTANT: Do not mention any game, movie, brand, or copyrighted visual style in code or comments. Keep code compact and readable. Ensure the file works standalone when opened in a browser. Make sure dat.gui CDN is the ONLY external script."}
